title: Bio-Dome Hydroponics & Veggie Systems
quickFact: Growing fresh salad greens in sealed environments using nutrient-rich water and LED light recipes.
explore: Astronauts on future Mars missions cannot rely on packaged food forever due to vitamin breakdown. NASA has tested the 'Veggie' and Advanced Plant Habitat (APH) aboard the ISS to grow red romaine lettuce, mizuna mustard, and radishes. Sealed Martian greenhouses recycle astronaut CO2 into fresh oxygen while providing nutrient-dense fresh food.
nasaMission: ISS Veggie Experiment & Kennedy Space Center Space Crop Production

refinementConversion.description: Replenishes crew morale and restores full Health Hearts.

checkQuestion.question: Why is growing fresh vegetables critical for a multi-year Mars mission?
options: Pre-packaged food loses essential vitamins over 3-year space transit
Martian gravity requires heavy plants for ballast
Plants are needed to cool the electrical generators
checkQuestion.explanation: Critical micronutrients such as Vitamin C and B1 degrade in shelf-stable space rations over time, making fresh hydroponic produce essential for crew health.
